# Cursor Changelog — captured 2026-06-01

## May 29, 2026 (Version 3.6) — Auto-review Run Mode
New run mode (Settings → Agents → Run Mode) allowing the agent to work longer with fewer approval prompts. Applies to Shell, MCP, and Fetch tool calls: allowlisted calls run immediately, sandboxable calls run in an isolated sandbox, and all other actions route to a classifier subagent that decides to allow, try a different approach, or request user approval. Classifier can be steered with custom instructions. (NEW since prior scan — reported 2026-06-01)

## May 20, 2026 (Version 3.5) — Shared Canvases
Teams can share interactive artifacts created by agents (dashboards, reports, custom interfaces) via browser links with read-only access. New external/cross-team sharing surface for agent-produced artifacts. Across Pro, Teams, and Enterprise plans.

## May 20, 2026 (Version 3.5) — /loop Skill
New agent skill: enables agents to run a prompt repeatedly on a local schedule, until a certain outcome is achieved (e.g., monitoring deployment status checks). Recurring/unattended scheduled agent execution on the local machine.

## May 20, 2026 — Improvements to Cursor Automations
Automations integrated into the Agents Window. Supports multi-repository configurations and standalone setups without repositories. New templates: Slack digest, analytics, FAQ, finance, customer health monitoring agents.

## May 19, 2026 — Cursor in Jira
Cursor integrated with Jira. Users can assign work items directly to cloud agents or mention @Cursor in Jira comments. The system uses ticket context to scope tasks and generates pull requests upon completion.

## May 18, 2026 — Composer 2.5
Upgraded Cursor model. Better long-running tasks, instruction following.
- Standard tier: $0.50/M input, $2.50/M output tokens
- Fast tier (default): $3.00/M input, $15.00/M output tokens

## May 13, 2026 (Version 3.4) — Full-screen Tabs and Compact Chats

## May 13, 2026 — Development Environments for Cloud Agents (multi-repo)
